teaching_language: Effectively fully English at the specialisation level, even though NOT listed on UNIPG's own 'entirely taught in English' page. Official presentation: "I CORSI DI BASE ED AVANZATI di entrambi i curricula sono tenuti in LINGUA INGLESE, alcuni insegnamenti opzionali sono tenuti in lingua italiana." Study plan count: Artificial Intelligence curriculum = 11 INGLESE / 0 ITALIANO; Cybersecurity curriculum = 12 INGLESE / 0 ITALIANO; shared modules = 5 INGLESE / 1 ITALIANO. Year 2 adds roughly 15 more English modules; only a small number of elective/careers modules remain Italian ('Attività a scelta dello studente', 'Analisi di metodi numerici', a careers module).

application_deadline_eu: EU/legally-residing applicants: PICA pre-enrolment from 1 July 2026 (no published closing date); SOL enrolment for open-access master closes 1 March 2027.
application_deadline_non_eu: IMPORTANT — do not confuse with the BSc Informatics deadline group: the UNIPG deadline table groups '...BSc Informatics...' under PICA 2026-visa-04 (closed 6 Aug 2026), but that explicitly refers to the BACHELOR's Informatics/Programmazione course, not this MASTER's Informatica (M0930, LM-18). This master's PICA group was not explicitly stated and most likely falls under the general window, PICA call 2026-visa-03, open 29 May-7 June 2026, 12:00 — CLOSED as of research date (2026-09-05) — but this is an inference and needs confirmation.

Non-EU/foreign-income students use a fixed Flat Tax by home-country UNDP Human Development bracket (Turkey = HIGH HD = EUR 800/year + EUR 16 stamp) or ISEEU Parificato via an affiliated CAF. Declaration window 3 Aug-20 Oct 2026 (late to 1 Mar 2027; missing 28 Feb defaults to the maximum band, ~EUR 2,096).
